Grunt1914 has been in Early Access for a few months now and has had a massive 65 updates in that time! The game has grown allot in that time and so has its community, we are now ready for the full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/0ff276dc15bfe6733bf6c44afefe55593e9d7fcd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Some of the updates have included major upgrades and improvements, in many forms. There have been updates for new weapons, features, mechanics, maps and many more. The game now has over 50 weapons and 14 maps each with day and night modes and each with three variant weather modes to choose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/0185303b5ed8c6f894ed7a9ae806afae55e26394.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

The time has come for the official full release, and even though we are moving out of early access we will keep working on the game and making it as good as possible!
